arithmetic: P_hat and C_eff from W12-F-1 contract; W32 Q29, sign/nonzero residual outside retained word; no product pack before addition

stages.work: Normalize P by fixed carry-dependent slices; prepare W32 P/C seeds, select anchor, compute signed wide delta and clamped shift
Right-align smaller seed; compute lost-bit reduction in parallel; retain residual sign/nonzero
Signed retained addition/subtraction, without product rounding
Take magnitude, convert opposing residual with a conditional one-grid-unit borrow, assert zero+tail unreachable
LOD/normalize and scale update; RNE-preserving fraction/sticky adapter under the W12 precision bound
Existing final RNE packer stages; only final Posit rounding

control: One owned A/B/C/config context until output retire; same reset bridge and leaf synchronous release convention as NF. Five elastic F slots, data/flags advance with valid; reset flushes pending. Accumulator commits rounded output once even under output stall; next context waits for retire.
adapter_detail: For W32 normalize the retained31-bit magnitude to hidden position30 and pad the30 fraction bits with23 zeros for F_IN53. Positive residual is a nonzero tail descriptor, not an exact fraction value. The precision bound ensures it lies below final G/R even after the allowed one-bit left normalization; do not claim the padded representation reproduces the full dyadic residual.
